find:
if (sm.isSimulating && action !== 'pause') return;
    if (action === 'confirm' && arrivedSincePoll) return; // pressed for the screen before
replace:
if (sm.isSimulating) return;
    if (action === 'confirm' && arrivedSincePoll) return; // pressed for the screen before
why: Start is the one action dispatched while a session simulates; gating it with the rest means a pad can never pause a round.
killedBy: createRouteHost: the gamepad menu poller (issue #494) Start pauses a simulating session and resumes a paused one; every other action is dropped mid-play
